item.name: 02 - AI Generation Evaluation
item.description: Run this folder with exactly 5 iterations only when Gemini quota use is intended. Each iteration creates a unique source to force fresh cache misses. The final request is a cache-hit diagnostic and is excluded from fresh metrics.

item.name: C6-AI-00 - Fresh Run Setup: Create Unique Notebook

item.name: C6-AI-01 - Fresh Run Setup: Add Unique Source

request.description: Adds unique controlled text for the current AI iteration; the unique marker changes the cache fingerprint.

body.raw:
{
  "notebook_id": "{{ai_notebook_id}}",
  "email": "{{ai_test_email}}",
  "type": "text",
  "title": "Data Structures {{ai_run_id}}",
  "content": "A stack is a linear last-in-first-out structure supporting push, pop and peek. A queue is a first-in-first-out structure supporting enqueue and dequeue. Breadth-first search explores graph vertices level by level with a queue. Depth-first search explores along a branch and can be implemented with a stack. Hash tables map keys to buckets and require collision handling. Binary search requires ordered input and repeatedly halves the search interval. Unique evaluation marker: {{ai_run_id}}."
}
